name: an Undo after its act settled reserves, projects and restores each field, and settles with what changed
an Undo requested before every segment settles waits for each source: a refused one owns nothing and its slot settles unnumbered
an inverse slot whose source is still held stops numbering, a restart included, until the source is authoritative
an edit queued after an Undo wins: the restore's ACK reclocks it above the server's fresh stamp
a field written away and back since its act skips on its own; its sibling restores
a Redo takes back only what its Undo applied
a candidate a pending local edit masks stays: that edit is refused, and the restore still applies
a materialized inverse replays after an epoch change only through its own entry, every operation skipping the other epoch
a foreign edit between the creation and a later write of the same act breaks the row history: the created record stays
a record whose every write since its creation is the act's own is deleted by its Undo
an act still wholly held is cancelled in place; asking again answers the same request, and an act with no journal is unavailable
a Discard at sign-in settles a pending inverse skipped and withdraws its values
